name: silvanexum-relay
summary: Silvanexum plugin for NVIDIA NeMo Relay. A grpc-v1 worker plugin that meters every LLM call to Silvanexum — the spend-control plane for AI agents — for server-side pricing and per-agent/per-customer attribution, and can reject an LLM call before it runs when a budget is exhausted. Ships a Relay pricing catalog for Nemotron and NIM models.
author: Silvanexum
